title.description: A short name for the pipeline, two to six words in sentence case with no final punctuation, like 'Monthly pharmacy spend by plan'.

headline.description: One sentence, under twenty words, that leads with what the pipeline will produce, like 'Monthly medical and pharmacy cost per member, with the top 100 by spend.' No first person.

nodes.description: Every node you plan to add or change, in build order. Existing nodes you'll only read from aren't listed here.

grain.description: What one row represents, in under ten plain words, like 'One row per member per month'.

purpose.description: What the node does, in under fifteen plain words.

from.description: The nodes it reads from, existing or planned, by name.

decisions.description: Choices the spec doesn't settle, including anything you'd otherwise ask about. Each one has the answer you'd build first; the person can switch it with a click before approving.

topic.description: The choice as a short question, under twelve words, like 'Which date puts a claim in the 12-month window?'

options.description: One to four short answers, each under eight words. The first is what you'll build; the rest are the likely alternatives.

open.description: True when you're guessing and the person should really decide. False for sensible defaults.

checks.description: Tests worth building into the nodes: invariants this pipeline depends on, where a violation would silently make the output wrong (duplicate rows at the declared grain, a join that could fan out, a total that must reconcile with its source). Usually one to three. The person picks which ones to build.

text.description: The check in under fifteen plain words.

why.description: What goes wrong downstream if it fails, in under twelve words.
